name: d6-standby-lock
summary: VCP D6=02..04 no longer sets the persistent 'DDC standby' key-lock bit (settings +0x4C bit 4)
status: verified-by-analysis; equivalent to specpatch 'd6-osd-lock' (other chat address 0x3692EE)
notes: In the Set-VCP D6 handler (inside sub_26AD19), values 2..4 set g_StandbyReq (0x4551AC bit 1) and OR 0x10 into settings byte +0x4C. Settings +0x48..+0xD1 are saved to the I2C EEPROM as one block (sub_26368B), so the bit survives power cycles. Its only reader is the key handler (0x258F7C). The only code that clears it is the monitor-settings default loader sub_262388 (first boot / version-change update), so neither VCP 04 nor a same-version reflash clears it. The standby request itself (bit 1 of 0x4551AC) is unchanged.
